import pandas as pd, re
f='/home/beeps/.local/share/idli-bench/codex/mixed_units.q3.codex.1/ws/mixed_units_register.xlsx'
df_raw=pd.read_excel(f, sheet_name=0, header=None)
header=df_raw.iloc[5].tolist()
data=df_raw.iloc[6:].copy()
data.columns=header
print(data.columns.tolist())
print(data.head(20))
# clean amount
def parse_amt(v):
    if pd.isna(v):
        return 0
    s=str(v).strip()
    if s=='' or s=='-' or s.upper()=='NA':
        return 0
    # remove ₹ , commas
    s=s.replace('₹','').replace(',','').strip()
    # handle L lakh, Cr, k
    m=re.search(r'([0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+)\\s*L', s, re.I)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))*100000
    m=re.search(r'([0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+)\\s*lakh', s, re.I)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))*100000
    m=re.search(r'([0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+)\\s*Cr', s, re.I)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))*10000000
    m=re.search(r'([0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+)\\s*k', s, re.I)
    if m:
        return float(m.group(1))*1000
    # try numeric
    try:
        return float(s)
    except:
        return 0
data['amount_num']=data['Amount'].apply(parse_amt)
odisha=data[data['State'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()=='odisha']
nonzero=odisha[odisha['amount_num']"'!=0]
print('"'total odisha rows', len(odisha))
print('nonzero', len(nonzero))
print(nonzero[['Record ID','State','Amount','amount_num']])
\"
"
